title: Raw go-livepeer Kafka GatewayEvent
description: Mixed-topic envelope emitted by monitor.SendQueueEventAsync at go-livepeer commit e8dcf7a34744d5cb6b65ba43c0d9160a3975ccc6. Consumers ignore unrelated event types and apply the create_signed_ticket schema only after filtering on type.

timestamp.description: Signed int64 Unix epoch milliseconds encoded as a decimal string. Consumers enforce the exact int64 bound.
